display_long_description:
Train like a top QB with a Meta Quest 3 experience built for serious pocket passing. Step into game-like reps inspired by the Top 8 concepts used at the highest levels—timing, anticipation, ball placement, progression reads, leverage, pressure response, mechanics consistency, and situational execution—then repeat them until they’re automatic.
Work from the pocket with realistic footwork, pocket movement, and quick decision-making. Deliver true-to-football throws with convincing release feel, spiral control, and flight behavior that rewards clean mechanics. Every rep is designed to sharpen throw motion: load, separation, release angle, velocity, and consistency—so what you build in VR transfers to the field.
This is made to augment in-person training with Mike Giovando, not replace it. Use VR between sessions to get more high-quality reps, stay locked into Mike’s coaching points, and track measurable improvement over time. You’ll get clear feedback and performance stats after drills so you can identify what’s slipping, reinforce what’s working, and show up to your next session ready to go deeper.
